summary: Dongyang Hengdian General Airport is a small general aviation facility located in Dongyang, a county-level city under the administration of Jinhua in Zhejiang Province, eastern China. The airport primarily serves the Hengdian area, which is internationally renowned as one of the world's largest film and television production bases. It operates as a general aviation airport, accommodating business, charter, and light aviation traffic rather than scheduled commercial flights.
faqs:
Q: Does Dongyang Hengdian General Airport offer commercial passenger flights?
A: No, this is a general aviation airport and does not operate scheduled commercial passenger services. It primarily handles business aviation, charter flights, and general aviation activity.

Q: Where is the airport located relative to Jinhua city center?
A: The airport is in Dongyang, roughly 50-60 km northeast of Jinhua's main urban area, and is more directly associated with the Hengdian township.

Q: What is the main attraction near the airport?
A: Hengdian World Studios, one of the largest film production complexes in the world, is located nearby and is the region's most famous landmark.

Q: Can private pilots use this airport?
A: Yes, as a general aviation facility it accommodates private and general aviation operations, subject to Chinese aviation authority approvals.
transport_tips: The airport is best reached by car or taxi from Dongyang city center, approximately 30-40 minutes by road, and about an hour from Jinhua. There is no direct rail or metro service; private hire through ride-hailing apps or pre-arranged transfers from hotels in Hengdian or Jinhua are the most common options. Drivers should note that local roads are well-maintained but signage in English can be limited.
local_tip: If you're flying into HEW, time your visit to explore Hengdian World Studios—many of the large-scale film sets are open to visitors and offer a unique look at Chinese cinema production, with some sets functioning as themed attractions year-round.
